review.note: Summary drafted in M41b from the two cached leads. It reaches the atlas through the Liberals, whose 1923 merger into it this record carries as a relation, and through them the election of 1921; no record here names the Nationalists directly.

summary: The Nationalist Republican Party was formed in 1923 out of the Republican Liberal Party, the Reconstitution Party and scattered figures of Sidónio Pais's old National Republican Party. It began as a moderate conservative party and drifted rightwards and towards Catholic opinion over the First Republic's last three years.
